target.statement: Zero-P-to-3 reaches 18.14 PSNR in the invisible region on Objaverse, the paper's key claim for partial-view reconstruction.

compute.basis: Even though the method is training-free, reproducing the metric needs Era3D multi-view diffusion, DiffBIR restoration, 50-step DDIM sampling over many rotated views, and iterative 3DGS optimization (3,000 steps per iteration) on 90-image partial observations; on an 8-core CPU this is days of runtime, not hours.

blockers: No code release or implementation link in the paper
Requires GPU inference for Era3D multi-view diffusion and DiffBIR restoration
Iterative refinement uses 3,000 3DGS optimization steps per iteration over many rotated views
Evaluation protocol, object list, renders, masks, and exact Objaverse split are unspecified
Multi-prior fusion and rotated-view hyperparameters are underspecified for exact reproduction
title: Zero-P-to-3: Zero-Shot Partial-View Images to 3D Object
